## What does this improve?

Describe the smallest synthetic reproduction and the observable before/after behavior.

## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run demo` pass or exact failures are listed
- [ ] For UI changes, the pinned real Chrome browser checks and 320px layout have been exercised, or gaps disclosed
- [ ] For CSV changes, both ordinary and formula-like cells have negative regression tests
- [ ] Source-only Pages allowlist remains minimal if publishing code changes
- [ ] No real customer/employer data, secrets, unlicensed assets or runtime network dependencies
- [ ] No unsupported live-hosting, accessibility or security certification claims

## Risks and limitations

What may be affected, what was not verified, and how can maintainers reproduce a failure?
